question: Which deities are named in this opening enumeration of the mantra's divine forms?
premises: The verse lists śukra-ātmā, bhāskara, ananta, deva-rāja, and śiva.
It closes with tathā, linking the list to what follows.
inference: This verse opens a sequential enumeration of deities associated with mantra components.
plain_english: Venus-soul, sun, endless one, king of gods, and Shiva are named thus.
